form_fields.label: My message
form_fields.value:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am asking on behalf of a small non-commercial project that reads cipher passages in digitised historical letters. One person directs the project and sends every message; the reading of images, the searches of editions and the checks are done by AI agents (Claude models) working in a public repository where every step is logged.

I would like to order a reproduction of a document in the Secrétairerie d'État et de Guerre fonds (T 100): register t. LXIV, f.16 (and f.16v), the instructions of 15 April 1648 to the abbé de Mercy, cited by Lonchay (1896, p.445 n.2). Per your online catalogue (AGATHA, BE-A0510_000027_002526), this item is digitised but reading-room-only, with no online image. Could you confirm the current modern register number corresponding to Lonchay's "t. LXIV," and let me know the fee and procedure for a digital reproduction of these two leaves? If a reading-room appointment is required instead, please let me know the notice period and how to book it.

I am not committing to any payment at this stage; I would just like the quote or the appointment procedure. Any reading we obtain will be published under an open licence, naming the archive and shelfmark, at https://github.com/NoAutopilot/cipher-lab

With thanks,
[SIGN-OFF]
